bom-card.proposedAction: Review the bill of materials before ordering

procurement-lines.proposedAction: Set the order quantity and rate, then create the PO

approval-card.proposedAction: See that the vendor PO is pending approval
approval-card.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the approval by the OEM approval admin, via email, cannot be shown. No approval screen is defined.

approve-po.proposedAction: Approve the vendor PO by email
approve-po.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the automatic email of the approved PO to {vendorPO.vendorName} (N17) cannot be shown.

inward-card.proposedAction: Receive the material and check its quality
inward-card.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so material inward receiving and quality check (N02) cannot be shown. The received count, shortfall, pass or fail per item and scrap are not defined.

inward-backdated.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so backdated data entry for purchase orders and material inward (N18) cannot be shown.
